(85)shar phyogs bhe la ka yi zhing khams na/ye shes lus can paṇa chen bi ma la/bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar nyer bzung ba/klong chen rab 'byams zhabs la gsol

tei:div.tei:p: (85)shar phyogs bhe la ka yi zhing khams na/ ye shes lus can paṇa chen bi ma la/ bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar nyer bzung ba/ klong chen rab 'byams zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ting 'jin ye shes gzungs sprin sanying po can/ shes rab spobs pa blo gros mi zad gter/ gsang chen 'od gsal bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che/ dri med 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ gsang chen rig 'jin 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi rje/ rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i khyab bdag dpal/ 'khor 'das chos kun ye shes chen por gzigs/ sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa'i rtsal chen dbyung*/ rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa nyi zla'i dkyil/ yin rloms snyigs ma'i nyams kyis sgrib pa'i dus/ 'di la khyed kyi thugs rje'i phyag rkyong la/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i ye shes gdangs/ yod min med min bsam 'das blo bral gshis/ ma nor ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ ma bcos gnas lugs yangs pa'i (86)bzhugs tshul dang*/ rtsal gdangs rol pa chu zla'i gar du rtogs/ chos rnams snang mnyam stong mnyam mnyam pa'i don/ rdzogs chen lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ rang bzhag cog bzhag chen po'i dgongs pa la/ sems 'jin gtad po'i mdung tshugs ma yin par/ rig stong rjen pa zangs thal rang bab gyi/ ma bcos bsgoms pa goms par byin gyis rlobs/ ye grol bsam ngo bral ba'i ye shes klong*/ rtogs tshogs rang grol shar grol chen por grol/ cir gyis bltas pas grol ba'i chos nyid mthong*/ mnyam pa chen po'i spyod pa klong rdol ba'i/ blang dor re dogs zad par byin gyis rlobs/ ngang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ sgrib pa'i glo bur dri ma dbyings su yal/ sems nyid gnyug ma chen po'i rgyal khab la/ 'jig rten bral bas 'khor ba'i chos bor zhing*/ ye sangs rgyas pas sangs rgyas rang yin pa'i/ re dogs thob 'dod zhen pa dbyings su yal/

gdod ma'i grub mtha' rnyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ kye ma kye hud klong chen rab 'byams pa/ byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ mos pa'i bu yis gdung ba'i nga ros 'bod/ 'di la khyed kyi snyan gyis ma gsan nam/ snyigs ma bas kyang yang snyigs deng song dus/ khyed ni rgyal ba sangs rgyas nyid du dran gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud bu la stsol/ chos brgyad rtog ngan 'khrul ba zhi ba dang*/ khyed kyi rjes su snyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ dge'o//
